reviews.name: Z M (Zjm123)
reviews.text: I brought in my Audi for an exhaust issue and it was taken care of the same day. I would definitely use this repair shop again - good prices and quality work.

reviews.name: Nesha Newton
reviews.text: Friendly kind and always take care of me! To me his costumer service is A1. He has been taking care of me for 4 years.

reviews.name: James Wagner
reviews.text: Great experience. My son and I brought a car here to check it out before we bought it. They checked it out, gave us solid info on some issues it had and what it would cost to fix them. Also told us it had been in an accident and bottomed out. That may have been a sign, because when we went to buy it, what was supposed to be a clean title was actually a rebuilt title. Thanks, Scally's! Highly recommend!

reviews.text: Gerry has been fixing my vehicles for years. Always a fair price and good work. He will take time to explain what needs to be repaired and why.

reviews.name: Clare F.
reviews.text:
My family has used Scally's for decades, and anytime I am back in the Philadelphia area and have car trouble, I go to them with full confidence that they will do the job right.
I have a classic Jeep pick up, (87 Comanche), and it's often a struggle to find mechanics who I feel like know how to work on it. Jerry and his team always do a great job on everything from body work to electrical. Their prices are reasonable, and I've never felt like they have overcharged me or done any work that wasn't necessary (which has happened with other mechanics). They are also all very nice, and patient when explaining what's going on and how to move forward.

reviews.name: George S.
reviews.text: Just seen reviews on yelp about these guys and decided to give them a try and im glad I did...Very nice guys had electrical problems on jeep but in 2 days problem was fixed ...They will be getting all my business from now on...

reviews.name: Susan L.
reviews.text: It's hard to find a reliable mechanic. Luckily, I found one at Scally's. I started going to them when they were located on Baltimore and Springfield, but now they moved near the Giant in Aldan but they are still in the area. Scally's never rips me off and helped me out in so many binds. When I had a flat tire, they fixed it immediately without making me wait. When I was in Japan and someone broke my car window, they replaced the window and stored my car in their garage until I came back from my trip. They do my oil changes, yearly inspections, and any other issues that I need with my car. Their prices are very fair and they treat you well.

reviews.name: Tyler W.
reviews.text: Amazing service ! Highly recommended! I never have any complaints, car always comes out working better than before, and so reasonably priced !!!

reviews.name: Ron B.
reviews.text: These guys are great! My parents have been using them for the past 2 years and they've done great work and never took them over. For instance, my moms headlight was developing some moisture problems. Dealer would install a new light fixture for $300. Scallys said they would simply drill a drainage hole in the light and let it clear out. Saved my mom a lot of money. Driving home this weekend from VA I noticed a shimmy in the wheel of my car was getting worse, especially when braking. Didn't want to drive on I-95 with that issue. Parents recommended I bring it by Scally shop since I was home for 3 days. I dropped the day after Thanksgiving and they were able to complete the work on it that day! Did repair/replacement of rear brakes and rotors, resurfaced the front rotors, fixed an exhaust hangar, oil change, all for $400. Compared to prices in the DC area, this was great! If I have an other major repairs I will def give them a ring, might pay to make the trip back up to PA.

reviews.name: Sarah S.
reviews.text: They moved to a bigger space behind the GIant. But their service is still amazing. They took a look at my car and fixed it right away. They didn't send me away and make me an appointment. They really know customer service.
